Jake (Support): hey team — EvoPilot trial is blocked on embed ingest, hitting intermittent 502s from our ingestion lambda. They onboarded 20k rows yesterday and nothing's finished. trial ends Mon, customer already asked about SLA. tagging CS for urgent weekend coverage and comms plan.

Maya (CS): on it. quick Q: do we have a short mitigation today or do they need us to run a manual import? who can be primary this weekend?

Jake (Support): logs are noisy, but root looks like transient upstream timeouts -> lambda retries then 502. sample from CloudWatch: ```Error: upstream timeout after 60s (POST /ingest) status=502 request_id=abc-123``` We can run a manual chunked import as a stopgap. I can do handoffs but not on-call over night.

Maya (CS): ok — I'll be primary contact for EvoPilot this weekend. Lee, can you be backup for any ingestion ops we need?

Lee (Solutions Eng): I can. quick suggestions: 1) toggle ingest concurrency to 2x for this customer, 2) enable fallback path to batch importer (slower but reliable), 3) send one-off email to CTO explaining workaround & ETA.

Ana (CS Manager): +1 on weekend cover. escalation notes: high renewal risk if onboarding not finished. Plan should include: immediate mitigation, customer-facing comms, and timeline to resolution. please post a short comms draft here and assign tasks.

Jake (Support): i've created a ticket: INC-3248 and flagged priority. ops-bot created it automatically.

ops-bot: Incident INC-3248 created by Jake (Support) — priority=P2 — assignees: Jake, Lee — https://internal.inc/INC-3248

Maya (CS): draft comms (short):
Hi Sam / EvoPilot team — thanks for flagging. We're seeing transient ingestion timeouts and have a manual import workaround to finish your dataset while we stabilize ingestion. Maya (redwood CS) will be your point — ETA to finish import: 6–12 hours after we start. We'll update you every 3 hours and once import completes we'll confirm next steps for long-term reliability. Apologies for the disruption.

Jake (Support): looks good. add a sentence about preserving data ordering. also include the contact for escalations: ana@redwood.com

Maya (CS): updated draft and posted to EvoPilot slack DM. ownership: Maya primary, Lee backup for ops, Jake to run the manual import procedure this evening at 20:00 PST, Ana to monitor renewal risk and coordinate billing if needed.

Lee (Solutions Eng): ops steps I'll take once Jake starts: 1) watch logs, 2) if timeouts recur >3x/min we flip to batch importer permanently for this account and open infra follow-up. I'll also pre-warm the batch importer.

Ana (CS Manager): good. please add the mitigation timeline to the renewal playbook and mark account as "at-risk" in CRM. I'll join the handoff call if things escalate.

Maya (CS): all set. I'll keep thread updates short: start -> import kicked off -> import finished -> follow-up items. tagging @Lee and @Jake here for visibility. :thumbsup:

Jake (Support): kick-off done at 1710605400. I'll DM creds to Maya.

Maya (CS): received creds, starting import now.

Lee (Solutions Eng): monitoring logs. so far steady, no repeat 502s.

Maya (CS): import completed at 1710605418. sending confirmation to EvoPilot now, scheduling 30m follow-up call Mon 10am PT to review permanence. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :tada:
